gradeRationale: No certainty is assigned to leads; see the appraisal of the retrieved records.
synthesis: Three further leads may be worth checking alongside the retrieved records: a study of pick-list design errors, a study of speech recognition errors in structured reports, and a report on multidisciplinary meeting preparation time.

items.title: Pick-list design and selection errors in structured radiology reports
items.keyFindings: Adjacent pick-list options were selected in error in about 1 in 300 reports until lists were reordered.

items.title: Speech recognition errors in structured and free-text radiology reports
items.keyFindings: Structured reports had fewer dictation errors in the findings section.

items.title: Structured reporting and preparation time for multidisciplinary cancer meetings
items.keyFindings: Preparation time for staging discussions fell after structured reports were introduced.

summary: Three leads suggested; one gives its year as text.
